hook: Their yacht broke in two and flipped. Three people in the lake.
narration: Their yacht broke in two and flipped over on Lake Erie, with three people in the water.
A helicopter crew from Coast Guard Air Station Detroit flew out to them.
The rescue swimmer rode the cable down and dropped into the lake.
He swims each survivor to the basket, [short pause] and the flight mechanic lowers it right to them.
One by one, they rode the basket up to the cabin door.
Below them, the broken hull was still floating upside down.
outcome: The Detroit aircrew rescued all three and got them safely back to shore.
title: Yacht broke in two on Lake Erie
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station Detroit helicopter crew hoisted three people from Lake Erie after the yacht they were aboard broke in two and capsized on May 16, 2016. All three were returned safely to shore.
